historical_growth.growth_rate_source: forward judgment: FY2026 revenue +5.6%, H1 FY2026 +1.4%, H2 FY2026 +7.7%; branded down apparel +8.7% (86% of revenue) against OEM -8.3%, ladieswear -14.3%, diversified -34.0%. The historical CAGRs are inflated by the FY2024 post-COVID step-up (+38.4%) and are not a forward base.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5y CAGR (10.5%) sits 30% below revenue 5y CAGR (15.1%) and 37% below EPS 5y CAGR (16.7%). This is by design, not a red flag: the payout ratio has exceeded 80% for five years, so book value compounds at roughly one-fifth of earnings growth. The selected forward growth (5.0%) is below all historical series.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; interest income is already outside the reported base). Owner and reported CAGRs are within 0.6pp because SBC is <1% of revenue; SBC is not outgrowing cash flow. FY2021 owner FCF 2,597.8 -> FY2026 5,302.3; FY2023 2,536.5 -> FY2026 5,302.3. The 3-year series is distorted by FY2023 being a low-WC year and FY2026 a +1,195 WC-inflow year.

scenario_narratives.base: Bosideng remains China's volume leader in down apparel and grows a little faster than the category: branded down apparel compounds at 7-8% for two more years while OEM, ladieswear and school uniforms keep shrinking, netting to ~5% group growth that fades to 2.5% by year 8. The EBITDA margin holds at the 24% achieved in each of FY2024-26 while 2025's duck-down cost spike is absorbed, then edges to 24.5% as AREAL/VERTEX premiumization, the exit from loss-making non-core lines and AI-led supply-chain gains outweigh rent and marketing. Capex normalises from 4% to 3% of revenue after the current flagship/warehouse build, cash tax stays at 28% because the 80%+ payout keeps PRC dividend withholding structural, and leases are expensed in full. The RMB16.6bn of surplus cash, time deposits and bank WMPs (less the final dividend already paid and a 5% repatriation haircut) is added at face. The 15x terminal cap binds.
scenario_narratives.bull: Premiumization works: Bosideng-brand ASP rises with Kim Jones' AREAL and Errolson Hugh's VERTEX, the Top Store programme lifts single-store productivity, Snow Flying keeps growing mid-teens at the mass end, Bogner and Moose Knuckles plus the Paris/London/Hong Kong flagships give the group a credible international leg, and OEM stabilises once tariff uncertainty settles. Group revenue grows 8% for two years (branded ~10%) and fades to 3%. Mix and pricing pass down-cost inflation through, and operating leverage plus the shrinking OEM share take the EBITDA margin to 26%. The sell-side's HK$5-6.4 targets correspond to the lower half of this case.
scenario_narratives.bear: The weather turns against the model two winters running and the Chinese consumer stays cautious: FY2027 revenue is flat (the H1 FY2026 +1.4% run-rate for a full year, with OEM down double digits on tariffs and ladieswear still destocking), and growth only recovers to 2%. Duck and goose down stay expensive, pricing power at the mid-market is squeezed between Moncler/Canada Goose above and Anta/Uniqlo below, and season-end markdowns take the EBITDA margin down 2.5pp to 21.5%. Store productivity weakens so lease cost rises as a share of sales, and the terminal multiple is capped at 12x for a slower, more weather-exposed business. Even here the business is solidly profitable and the net cash pile is intact; the bear case is a de-rating of the growth story, not solvency.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Bosideng is a mature, cash-generative category leader whose value is roughly two-fifths net cash and three-fifths a 12-13% owner-FCF-margin stream growing at low-to-mid single digits. The valuation hinges on three things: whether the 24% EBITDA margin survives down-cost inflation and warm winters, how fast the China down-jacket category decelerates, and whether the RMB16.6bn of surplus financial assets (half of it bank WMPs at FVPL) is treated as shareholder cash. Leases are expensed in full (treatment B), SBC is immaterial but kept explicit, the final dividend already paid is removed from the cash pile, and a 5% PRC withholding haircut is applied to the surplus cash. The 15x terminal cap (12x in the bear case) binds in every scenario, so the valuation does not depend on a Gordon re-rating. The 80% payout ratio means most of the modelled FCF actually reaches shareholders as HKD dividends, which is what makes the HKD-per-share comparison meaningful despite the RMB flows.
key_risks_to_valuation: Weather: a warm winter directly reduces sell-through and forces discounting; two consecutive warm winters is the bear case's main axis
Raw-material cost: 90% white duck down rose ~35% through 2025; a sustained high price that cannot be passed through takes 1-2pp off the EBITDA margin
China consumer discretionary demand and property-wealth effects; the branded business is almost entirely domestic
Treatment of surplus financial assets: RMB8.7bn of bank wealth-management products are FVPL with no principal guarantee; a 10% impairment would be ~RMB0.08/share
Repatriation: surplus cash sits in PRC subsidiaries; withholding and capital-control friction could exceed the 5% haircut assumed
Non-core segment decline (OEM -8%, ladieswear -14%, diversified -34% in FY2026) continuing to dilute group growth and incur restructuring costs
RMB/HKD: per-share values are converted at 1.1746; a 5% RMB depreciation moves the HKD IV by 5%

inputs.share_count_basis: 11,688,971k ordinary shares issued and fully paid at 31 March 2026 (FY2025/26 AR note 35(c), Annual_FY2025.txt:9130). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The FY2026 diluted weighted average (11,670.8m, note 13) is below the year-end issued count only because 152.9m shares were issued for share awards during the year; the year-end issued figure is the higher and later number.
inputs.cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents 2,977.0 + time deposits 4,870.7 (current 3,480.7 + non-current 1,390.0) + bank wealth-management products at FVPL 8,708.6 (current 8,135.7 + non-current 572.9; underlying assets are government/corporate bonds, bank deposits, ABS and money-market funds per note 26(a)(ii), no single counterparty >5% of total assets). All three are surplus financial assets whose income (finance income RMB478.6m) sits below EBITDA and outside the flows, so under the matching-asset rule they belong in net cash. Pledged bank deposits (403.4, backing bills payable) are operating and EXCLUDED. Borrowings 957.0 are bank loans only (RMB760m fixed/floating + JPY197m); lease liabilities (712.4) are excluded because leases are charged in the flows (treatment B).
inputs.interest_income_note: Set to 0 because the CSV's reported FCF (OCF 6,432.3 - capex 1,083.3) already excludes every element of the RMB478.6m finance income: HKFRS classifies interest received (177.3) in investing, and the RMB255.6m fair-value gain on wealth-management products and RMB124.5m net interest income are reversed out of OCF (Annual_FY2025.txt:5837-5842). Deducting 478.6 again would strip income that is not in the base. The source assets of that income are in net cash (see cash_composition), so the matching-asset rule is satisfied.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025/26 consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based transactions' RMB46,687k (Annual_FY2025.txt:7096). Equity-award taxes are nil (no net-share settlement withholding disclosed; KPI EquityAwardTaxes = 0 all years).
inputs.buyback_note: Payments for purchase of own shares RMB18.2m FY2026 (222.7m FY2025). Small and offset by share-award issuance (RMB317.5m option-exercise proceeds); the flat count is a modelling convention funded only partly by repurchases.
inputs.fx_note: CNY/HKD 1.1746 (1 CNY = 1.1746 HKD), Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23. Statements and all flows are RMB; HKEX quote and dividends are HKD. Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1746 into HKD. Parity check: the FY2026 final dividend of HKD25.0 cents is stated by the company as 'equivalent to approximately RMB21.7 cents' (Annual_FY2025.txt:2736), i.e. 1.152 HKD per CNY at the June 2026 rate -- same direction, within 2% of today's rate. No dual listing exists for a price parity check.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y China government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.0 x (mature-market ERP 6.0% + China country risk premium 1.2%) = 9.0% cost of equity. Net cash balance sheet and investment-grade ratings (Moody's Baa3 positive / S&P BBB- stable) mean WACC = cost of equity. Weather, down-price and China-consumer risk is charged ONCE, in the scenario flows and weights, not as a WACC premium; the same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B): leases as operating cost. The full lease cash cost -- capital element of lease liabilities paid RMB514.3m (financing, Annual_FY2025.txt:5890) plus interest on lease liabilities RMB39.1m (note 10, :7551) = RMB553.5m, 2.02% of FY2026 revenue -- is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (712.4) are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. D&A for cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation on leased properties: total D&A 1,279.7 (depreciation 1,216.5 + amortisation 63.2) less ROU-property depreciation 576.7 (note 16, :7547) = 703.0, 2.57% of revenue. Land-use-right ROU depreciation (25.8) stays in D&A because land use rights are purchased, not rented. Variable lease payments (RMB2,035m) and short-term leases (75m) are already in opex above EBITDA. Reported FCF 5,349.0 is flattered by the 514.3 lease principal in financing; owner FCF after lease principal is 4,788.0.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged once, in the bridge: non-controlling interests of RMB163.4m at 31 March 2026 deducted via equity_bridge; flows are modelled on consolidated profit (NCI share of profit is only RMB52.7m, 1.3%). FY0 check: component EBIT 5,272 x (1-28%) = 3,796 NOPAT vs reported attributable net income 3,994 + finance income excluded (-478.6 pre-tax) -- ties within non-operating noise.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row: operating company, non-US, consumer/cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + adaptations a, b, c, d, e). Bosideng is a branded down-apparel retailer/manufacturer with a net-cash balance sheet; no memory entry existed, so this is the first valuation. Fresh build, no reconciliation. Filing-name trap: Annual_FY2025.txt is the FY2025/26 report (year ended 31 March 2026); core_metrics labels are already correct. The current price is a regular-session close, not volatile. The valuation date (2026-10-23) is ~7 months after the balance sheet; the FY2026 final dividend (HKD25.0c, paid 2026-09-15) has left the balance sheet and the share price is ex, so it is deducted in equity_bridge. H1 FY2027 (six months to 30 September 2026) is not yet published (due late November 2026); H1 is seasonally cash-negative (H1 FY2026 OCF -1,084) but that is working-capital timing that reverses in H2 and is not deducted. Working capital: payables (8,688) exceed inventories + receivables + prepayments (6,650), so the business runs on negative working capital, but annual swings are large (+1,195 FY2026, -726 FY2025), so wc_capture is 0 in the base. Component anchors tie in-sample: FY2026 component owner FCF ex-WC 3,416 vs actual 3,593 (gap = impairment 148 + disposal losses 50 inside EBITDA). FY2026 cash tax paid / PBT = 26.4%, income tax expense / PBT = 28.2% (includes PRC dividend withholding tax on upstreamed profits, structural given the 80% payout); FY2025 was 33.4% / 31.0%. A 28% cash rate is used in the base. SBC is tiny (0.17% FY2026, 0.62% FY2025, 0.43% FY2024; 3-year average 0.41%), so the house/street band is narrow but not zero.

bear.growth_rationale: A second consecutive warm winter plus a weak Chinese consumer: FY2027 flat (a repeat of H1 FY2026's +1.4% for the whole year, with OEM down double digits on tariffs). Growth recovers only to 2%, roughly China CPI, as the category stops gaining share of wallet and premiumization stalls against Moncler/Canada Goose at the top and Anta/Uniqlo below.
bear.margin_rationale: Down-price inflation not passed through and winter-end discounting take 2.5pp off EBITDA margin to 21.5% (still above FY2023's 22.5% less the lease adjustment, so not a collapse). Lease cost drifts up to 2.3% on weaker store productivity; cash tax 29%; growth consumes 5% of incremental revenue in inventory. Terminal multiple capped at 12x for a slower, more weather-exposed business.

base.growth_rationale: FY2027 +5.0%: branded down apparel +7-8% (store productivity, Snow Flying, modest ASP uplift) diluted by continued OEM/ladieswear/diversified shrinkage (~14% of revenue, falling high single digits). Decelerates to 2.5% by year 8 as the China down-jacket category matures.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA margin held at the FY2024-26 level (24.2/23.9/24.0%) for two years while down-cost inflation (90% white duck down ~RMB425->570/kg through 2025) is absorbed, then drifts +0.5pp to 24.5% as premiumization (AREAL, VERTEX), the exit from loss-making non-core lines and AI-driven supply-chain efficiency take effect. Lease cost 2.1% (FY2026 2.02%, FY2025 2.36%). D&A ex-ROU 2.6% (FY2026 2.57%). Capex 3.5% easing to 3.0% (FY2026 3.96% incl. flagship/warehouse build; FY2023-24 average 2.7%). Cash tax 28% = 25% statutory + PRC dividend withholding on the 80% payout.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 9.0% / 2.5% implies 15.8x terminal FCF; the 15x cap binds -- appropriate for a weather-dependent consumer business at maturity.

bull.growth_rationale: Premiumization lands: Bosideng-brand ASP rises with AREAL/VERTEX and the Top Store programme, Snow Flying keeps growing mid-teens, Bogner/Moose Knuckles and overseas flagships add a second leg, OEM stabilises. Group growth 8% for two years (branded ~10%), decelerating to 3% by year 10. Still below the FY2019-26 average.
bull.margin_rationale: Down costs passed through via mix and pricing; EBITDA margin expands 2pp to 26% over six years on operating leverage from single-store productivity and the shrinking share of low-margin OEM. Capex held at 3.5% to fund flagship and international expansion; cash tax 27% on a slightly lower withholding mix. Negative-WC retailer captures 5% of incremental revenue as cash.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because the two main bear axes -- an unexpectedly warm winter and duck-down cost inflation -- are recurring, largely unhedgeable events that have already appeared (H1 FY2026 growth 1.4%, FY2026 commentary), not tail risks, and the business is ~100% exposed to one geography's consumer. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right at once: premiumization against entrenched luxury incumbents, international expansion from a near-zero base, OEM stabilisation and full pass-through of input costs. Base at 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
